stemMd: When P(x)=x cubed−2x+7 is divided by x−2, what is the remainder?
explanationMd: The remainder theorem gives P(2)=8−4+7=11. Polynomial long division would give the same constant remainder.

distractorRationale.b: This subtracts the cubic contribution incorrectly.
distractorRationale.e: This adds 2x instead of subtracting it.
